facts.text: Serve the noodles when David makes Michael see his rice as maggots.
facts.why: The pages I read say David's illusion makes Michael's food look like worms, and the famous line is about the noodles turning into worms. I could not confirm the rice as maggots detail. The cue is printed on the card.
facts.fix: Serve the noodles when David makes Michael see his noodles as worms.

facts.text: "Nobody touches my root beer. Taxidermy supplies are in the back, so mind the stuffed animals."
facts.why: Grandpa never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Grandpa, so it reads as a film line. His famous line is the last one in the film. I could not open a quote page, so this is from memory.
facts.fix: One thing about living in Santa Carla I never could stomach: all the damn vampires.

vibe.verdict: Santa Carla's boardwalk is the right setting and the noodles cue is a good pick, but the surf report strip and plain dishes feel generic.
